_help: Rules terms ('keywords'): words that get a hover definition everywhere they appear. 'kind' is rule, condition or action. Terms are matched with the same capitalization; conditions also match lowercase. 'aliases' are other spellings to match.

keywords.description: While Inspired, you add 1d4 to one ability check of your choice before the condition ends.
A place you know well. You have Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to navigate it.
